title: Signal & Soul Story Detail Pages
requirements: Dynamic story detail pages with rich editorial layout (kicker, title, hero image, body paragraphs).
Unique slugs and custom body content for all stories in the magazine.
Working navigation from the homepage story cards to their respective detail pages.
Verifiable E2E test coverage for the story detail interaction.

acceptance.text: Dynamic detail route app/stories/[slug]/page.tsx exists and renders kicker, title, hero image, and 2-3 paragraphs of body.
Each entry in STORIES in lib/content.ts has a unique slug and 2-3 paragraphs of body.
Story cards in components/Stories.tsx link to /stories/<slug> instead of #feature.
E2E test successfully clicks 'The case for closed-back' and asserts that a phrase from that story's body is present on the page.

plan: Update lib/content.ts to add slug and body to each story in STORIES.
Create app/stories/[slug]/page.tsx dynamic route with beautiful editorial styling.
Update components/Stories.tsx to link each story card to /stories/[slug].
Run E2E test to verify the navigation and content rendering.
evidence: #1: run_e2e passed with 4/4 steps verifying the dynamic story detail page navigation and rendering
